text:
Asha (Finance): Recon picked up ~78 Stripe payments marked 'succeeded' with no NetSuite invoice. Detected 11:12 UTC. Can payments/ops triage?

Ben (Payments): Checking Stripe logs. I see a batch of webhook deliveries rejected by billing-sync around 11:08-11:14. Any recent deploys?

billing-bot: ALERT: /webhooks/netsuite delivery failures 11:07:50 - 11:14:22 UTC. Failed events: 78. Error summary: 61 x SignatureVerificationError, 17 x UpstreamHTTP(500). Details: /ops/webhooks/alerts/1742601122

Luca (Backend): We rotated NETSUITE_WEBHOOK_SECRET during the 11:00 deploy and enabled strict timestamp check (±120s). Logs show many failures with "SignatureVerificationError: timestamp outside tolerance" and several 500s from NetSuite when retry loops hit partial create paths.

Marta (Ops): I reverted to keep previous secret as fallback and restarted billing-sync at 11:18 UTC. Added extra logging for the raw stripe-signature header.

Ben (Payments): Example event: evt_5RstUv - invoice.payment_succeeded, metadata.external_invoice_id=INV-2026-04-02-77. Pushed a sample to backfill queue.

Luca (Backend): Hotfix: verifier now accepts current + previous secret for 36h and will log both headers. Changing retry logic: treat NetSuite 409 on externalId as idempotent (fetch existing) instead of retrying create. Pushing patch.

billing-bot: DEPLOYMENT: billing-sync v2.19.0-hotfix deployed by Luca at 11:21 UTC. Health checks passing.

Marta (Ops): Opened NetSuite ticket NS-10111 for partial-create cleanup and to request temporary locks on conflicting external_id keys. Asked for ETA 1-3 hours.

Asha (Finance): Please export CSV for CS: stripe_event, external_invoice_id, customer_email, amount_cents, currency, stripe_status. Also want a count of affected customers.

Ben (Payments): CSV generated: /finance/recon/ops/1742601122-missing_invoices.csv. 78 events -> 70 unique customers. Backfill queued but we'll wait for NetSuite to confirm cleanup for items that hit partial create.

Luca (Backend): Backfill plan: dedupe by stripe_event_id, attempt create -> on 409 GET existing, on 5xx mark for manual review. I'll also add a guard to avoid multiple concurrent create attempts for the same external_id.

billing-bot: JOB: recon-backfill queued (job_id=rb-1742601122-1).

Ben (Payments): Manual backfill executed at 11:37 UTC after rollback to previous secret. Progress: processed=78 created=66 fetched_existing=3 blocked=9 flagged_manual=0. Detailed CSV at the path above.

Marta (Ops): NetSuite acknowledged NS-10111: clearing 9 partial records now; asked to pause retries for ~45m.

Asha (Finance): Impact summary: 78 events delayed, payments captured in Stripe for all; 66 invoices created by backfill, 3 fetched as existing, 9 pending cleanup by NetSuite. No duplicate charges. Please include root cause and remediation in a short postmortem: secret rotation timing + strict tolerance + retry logic treating 409 as retryable + partial create rollback handling.

Luca (Backend): Will draft postmortem and PRs: 1) dual-secret verifier for 48h, 2) pre-rotation checklist to sync Stripe signing secret via API, 3) change 409 handling to idempotent GET, 4) implement per-external_id create lock, 5) add alert for signature-failure spikes (>10 in 5m). ETA draft: EOD.

Ben (Payments): Sent CSV and summary to CS. No customer refunds required.

Marta (Ops): Added alert rule and Slack escalation to #eng-oncall and #finance. Monitoring until NetSuite confirms cleanup.

billing-bot: RESOLVED: webhook delivery spike ended 11:57 UTC. Monitoring until 12:30 UTC.
